messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT 3387654321 - Post-deploy latency & 5xx spike on runtime slice-A. Severity P2 -> paging eng-oncall. Summary: ~60% increase in p99 for long sequences, ~2% elevated 5xx. Triggered after rollout at 04:50 UTC. Investigate in channel. Link: https://infra.ops/alerts/3387654321

Ryan (oncall): taking this. looking at dashboards now. p50 steady, p99 jump concentrated at seq_len > 1024 and batches > 32.

Sasha (eng-runtime): saw kernel fallback logs on a subset of hosts in us-west2. heuristics change in batching_v2 seems correlated with larger batch packing causing mem pressure -> fallback to reference kernel. deploy finished ~04:50.

Maria (SRE): confirmed OOM-estimate + fallback in logs. snippet:
```
runtime: kernel_fallback=true reason=oom_estimate batch_size=48 seq_len=1536 node=gw-12
```

Ryan (oncall): customer impact: small % of requests hit 5xx/504, latency tails increased. Top affected tenants: chatly (~5m error window), docscribe (timeouts). If we don't mitigate in 15m, escalate to P1 and notify customers.

Tess (Product): support already seeing tickets. please keep me posted if we need a customer-facing note.

Sasha (eng-runtime): quick mitigation plan: flip batching_v2_heuristic -> off on slice-A, reduce canary traffic, and prepare rollback of runtime:v2.4.0 canary. Will push flag now.

deploy-bot: Command received: flip-flag batching_v2_heuristic=false --scope=slice-A (id=fb-3387)

Maria (SRE): flag flip completed. within ~90s p99 dropped ~40% and 5xx rate back toward baseline. CPU on non-optimized paths increased slightly; watching. kernel_fallback logs reduced but not zero.

Ryan (oncall): good improvement. still seeing some fallback traces. recommendation: throttle canary traffic to 30% and start controlled rollback for runtime:v2.4.0 on canaries. initiating rollback.

Sasha (eng-runtime): running: /deploy rollback runtime:v2.4.0 --group=canary --reason="postdeploy latency regression"

deploy-bot: Rollback job rb-3387 started for group canary. ETA ~6m.

Maria (SRE): rollback completed on canary. canary p99 normalized and no new 5xx in last 10m. Keeping batching_v2_heuristic disabled until we validate a fix.

Ryan (oncall): handoff to morning oncall (Maria) in 20m. I'll write a short incident timeline and action items in the incident doc. action items: collect flamegraphs, collect kernel fallback traces, revert heuristic PR and add seq_len guardrail tests, add rollout canary throttle by default. Owners: Sasha -> runtime fix, Maria -> rollout process/automation, Tess -> customer comms.

Tess (Product): drafting short note for impacted accounts and support triage.

Ryan (oncall): marking incident as mitigated for now. reopening if metrics regress. thanks all :thumbsup:
